prompt: In the style of a cinematic film still, a bustling snowy town square unfolds under a grey sky. On the left, a woman in a blue coat stands holding a steaming cup of coffee, her breath visible in the cold air. Next to her, a black lamppost rises tall, its glass casing frosted over with ice. A small child in a yellow hat sits on the base of this lamppost, tying the laces of their red boots. In the center, an old stone fountain is frozen solid, topped with a thick layer of white snow. A brown dog stands next to the fountain, sniffing at a discarded glove lying on the ground. Behind the dog, a man in a green jacket points toward the distant clock tower, his arm extended firmly. To his right, a vendor in an apron hands a paper bag of pretzels to a customer in a grey beanie. The customer looks at the vendor with a smile, clutching a few coins in their mittened hand. Near the edge of the frame, a wooden bench is occupied by an elderly person in a wool scarf, who is reading a newspaper. A pigeon perches on the backrest of this bench, pecking at crumbs near the reader's elbow. In the background, a horse-drawn carriage waits patiently, the horse wearing a decorative bridle. The driver in a top hat sits atop the carriage, holding the reins loosely. A stray cat hides beneath the carriage wheels, its eyes wide and alert. There is no modern car visible in the scene. There is no digital billboard present. The snow covers every surface uniformly, creating a serene yet active atmosphere where each figure contributes to the narrative of a winter day.
